# Heavenly Scent Grooming

> Mobile pet grooming for dogs and cats, delivered at the customer's home across Ann Arbor, Michigan and the surrounding communities. Experienced, reliable, and hassle-free: the grooming van comes to you, so pets are never crated or left waiting.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/): Services, pricing, service area, and booking
- [Services](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/#services): Full groom, bath only, nail trim, ear cleaning, specialty cut
- [About](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/#about): Who we are, our mission, and why mobile grooming
- [Pricing](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/#pricing): Price ranges by service and pet size
- [Service Locations](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/#locations): Communities covered
- [Contact](https://heavenlyscentgrooming.com/#contact): Request an appointment

## Services

- Full Groom: Complete bath, haircut, nail trim, and ear cleaning.
- Bath Only: Wash, dry, and brush-out without a haircut.
- Nail Trim: Standalone nail trimming.
- Ear Cleaning: Standalone ear cleaning.
- Specialty Cut: Breed-standard or custom styling.

## Contact

- Phone: (734) 218-6141

## Hours and Location

Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Mobile service based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, serving Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti, Chelsea, Saline, Milan, and Superior Township. Price range is $50 to $300 depending on service, pet size, and coat condition.

## About

Heavenly Scent Grooming is a mobile pet grooming business serving the Ann Arbor, Michigan area. Grooming is performed in a fully equipped van at the customer's address, which removes travel stress for the animal and waiting time for the owner. Dogs and cats are both welcome.
